title: Crumb Vault Entry (crumb.vault-entry v1)
description: At-rest file (`<site>/<account>.crumb`) holding one encrypted crumb.session plus its clear-text, value-free descriptor so accounts can be listed without the key.

keyStore.description: Where the 256-bit vault key lives. Informational; the key itself is never stored here.

aad.description: Additional authenticated data is the UTF-8 account id, binding the ciphertext to this account.

ciphertext.description: AES-256-GCM encryption of the UTF-8 JSON crumb.session document.
